# https://deepakai.in

## About DeepAKAI
DeepAKAI (Deepak AI Solutions) is an Indian company that builds AI-powered
WhatsApp chatbots for small and medium businesses (SMBs) across India.
Founded by Deepak Maurya, based in South West Delhi, India.

## What We Do
- Build AI-powered WhatsApp chatbots using Meta's official WhatsApp Business API
- Automate 24/7 replies, appointment booking, FAQ answers, lead capture, and daily reports
- Serve clinics, coaching institutes, restaurants, salons & spas, real estate agencies,
  D2C brands, CA & legal firms, and gyms across India
- Bots go live within 48 hours of sign-up
- Bots reply in Hindi, English and Hinglish

## Pricing
- Essential Plan: ₹2,500/month
- Customized Plan: ₹5,000/month
- Both plans include a free 15-day trial, no credit card required
- Setup fee currently free (limited time)

## Compliance
Data handling is aligned with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).
Full privacy policy: https://deepakai.in/privacy-policy.html

- Clinics & Doctors: https://deepakai.in/clinics.html - WhatsApp chatbot for clinics with appointment booking requests, instant answers to patient questions and 24/7 replies
- Salons & Spas: https://deepakai.in/salons.html - WhatsApp chatbot for salons and spas with appointment booking requests, instant answers to client questions and 24/7 replies
- Restaurants: https://deepakai.in/restaurants.html - WhatsApp chatbot for restaurants with table booking requests, instant answers to customer questions and 24/7 replies
- Coaching Institutes: https://deepakai.in/coaching.html - WhatsApp chatbot for coaching institutes with course and fee info, demo class booking requests and 24/7 replies to student enquiries
- Real Estate: https://deepakai.in/real-estate.html - WhatsApp chatbot for real estate agents with buyer lead capture, instant answers to property questions and 24/7 replies
- D2C Brands: https://deepakai.in/d2c-brands.html - WhatsApp chatbot for D2C brands with instant answers to product questions, lead capture and 24/7 replies
- CA & Legal Firms: https://deepakai.in/ca-legal.html - WhatsApp chatbot for CA and legal firms with instant answers to service and fee questions, consultation requests and 24/7 replies
